title: Paying Back a Debt Early
paragraphs: Setelah menerima bonus tak terduga di kantor, pikiran pertama Zayn adalah akhirnya membayar kembali pinjaman pribadi yang diberikan seorang teman dua tahun lalu, meski pembayarannya belum jatuh tempo selama setahun lagi.
Istrinya menyarankan menggunakan uang itu untuk kebutuhan rumah tangga mendesak lainnya, karena temannya tidak pernah sekali pun menyebutkan atau menekannya soal sisa saldo selama dua tahun itu.
Zayn tetap bersikeras membayarnya, menjelaskan bahwa kesabaran dan kepercayaan temannya pantas dihormati dengan segera, bukan diulur hanya karena tidak ada tekanan langsung untuk membayar.

Temannya benar-benar tersentuh oleh pembayaran lebih awal itu, kemudian memberi tahu Zayn bahwa jarang ada orang yang membayar utang lebih cepat dari jadwal, dan sikap ini memperkuat persahabatan mereka secara signifikan.
answerKey: After receiving an unexpected bonus at work, Zayn's first thought was to finally pay back a personal loan a friend had given him two years earlier, even though repayment was not due for another year. His wife suggested using the money for other pressing household needs instead, since their friend had never once mentioned or pressured him about the remaining balance during those two years. Zayn insisted on repaying it anyway, explaining that his friend's patience and trust deserved to be honored promptly rather than stretched out simply because there was no immediate pressure to repay. His friend was genuinely moved by the early repayment, later telling Zayn that few people repaid debts ahead of schedule, and that this gesture strengthened their friendship considerably.
